instruction: Open C:\Users\User\Desktop\rest_shape.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\tools.csv in SolidCAM. Use T1 to clear the main pocket in C:\Users\User\Desktop\rest_shape.step, then use T2 for Dynamic Rest Mill on all small-radius corners and narrow remaining regions. The target floor is Z=6.000 mm. Tool definitions: T1 is a 12 mm end mill for clearing; T2 is a 4 mm end mill for rest machining. Write the required output file(s) to the Desktop using exactly these absolute paths: C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-08.nc. [Software] SolidCAM runs inside SOLIDWORKS; start SOLIDWORKS from `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\` first (adjust path).
